title: Two militiamen and a civilian killed in a motorcycle ambush in Manungkaling, Mamasapano
summary: CAFGU Active Auxiliary members Samsamin Kabagani and Danny Minandang and their civilian companion Esmael Manabilang were riding a motorcycle in Barangay Manungkaling, Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur, on the morning of Saturday, 7 November 2026, when unidentified armed men opened fire on them. All three died at the scene. A resident, Mohamidin Usman, was hit by a stray bullet and taken to hospital. The gunmen escaped on separate motorcycles; police had not determined a motive.

title: Village councilman wounded in an ambush on his multicab in Balanaken, Datu Piang
summary: Abdul Manab Guialodin, a councilor of Barangay Liong, Datu Piang, Maguindanao del Sur, was driving his multicab to the town center at about 11 a.m. on Friday, 6 November 2026, when a lone gunman hiding behind a coconut tree in Barangay Balanaken opened fire. He was hit in the arm and back, was taken to hospital by Datu Piang police, and was reported stable. The gunman fled; police recovered five empty shells.

sources.title: Maguindanao del Sur village councilman survives ambush
